About the Role

As the People Business Partner at GoTo Financial, you will work closely with business leaders and managers to support their people and organizational needs. You will provide practical HR advice, manage employee matters, and drive people initiatives across performance management, talent development, and employee engagement. You will take ownership of your assigned business areas, working with different stakeholders to ensure HR solutions are implemented effectively.

What You Will Do

• Partner with business leaders and managers to understand people challenges and provide practical HR advice and solutions.
• Drive key HR processes, including performance management, talent reviews, promotions, and employee engagement, ensuring consistent and timely execution.
• Manage employee relations matters, including performance concerns, grievances, and disciplinary cases, with appropriate guidance and escalation when needed.
• Support workforce planning, organizational changes, and talent development initiatives based on business needs.
• Ensure HR practices and documentation comply with internal policies, applicable labor laws, audit standards, and regulatory requirements.
• Coordinate HR-related internal and external audits, regulatory reviews, and compliance activities, including evidence preparation, issue tracking, and timely closure of corrective actions.
• Collaborate with HR teams and business stakeholders to deliver people initiatives, identify risks, and ensure timely execution of agreed action plans.

What You Will Need

• 8-10 years of relevant HR experience, including hands-on experience in HR business partnering or HR generalist roles within the fintech industry.
• Hands-on experience supporting regulatory engagements and audits, including preparing HR-related documentation, coordinating regulatory requests, and following up on findings.
• Working knowledge of HR compliance, applicable labor regulations, audit requirements, and HR documentation standards; experience in an OJK-regulated industry is an advantage.
• Ability to independently support managers, identify people-related issues, and recommend practical solutions with sound judgment.
• Strong attention to detail and risk awareness, with the ability to maintain accurate records, identify compliance gaps, and follow through on corrective actions.
• Good communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to collaborate effectively across HR, business, compliance, and audit teams.
• Strong execution, analytical, and problem-solving skills, with the ability to manage multiple priorities and deliver results in a fast-paced environment.

About the Team

About GoTo Group
GoTo is the largest digital ecosystem in Indonesia. GoTo's mission is to 'empower progress' by offering technology infrastructure and solutions that help everyone to access and thrive in the digital economy.
The GoTo ecosystem provides a wide range of services, including mobility, delivery, payments, financial services, and technology solutions for merchants. The ecosystem also provides e-commerce services through Tokopedia and banking services through its partnership with Bank Jago.

About Gojek
Gojek is Southeast Asia’s leading on-demand platform and pioneer of the multi-service ecosystem with over 2.5 million driver partners across the regions offering a wide range of services such as transportation, food delivery, logistics and more. With its mission to create impact at scale, Gojek is committed to resolving consumer problems and raising standards of living by connecting consumers to the best providers of goods and services in the market.

About GoTo Financial
GoTo Financial accelerates financial inclusion through its leading financial services and merchants solutions. Its consumer services include GoPay and GoPayLater and serve businesses of all sizes through Midtrans, Moka, GoBiz Plus, GoBiz, and Selly. With its trusted and inclusive ecosystem of products, GoTo Financial is open to new growth opportunities and aims to empower everyone to Make It Happen, Make It Together, Make It Last.

Founded in 1966, Kalbe Farma (Kalbe) is the largest publicly-listed pharmaceutical company in Southeast Asia. As of end 2023, Kalbe’s extensive healthcare ecosystem encompasses a network of 47 companies, including subsidiaries, joint ventures, and associates, all driven by a dedicated workforce of 16,795 employees.

Guided by a vision to become the country’s best global healthcare company, Kalbe offers a comprehensive healthcare solution through its four key business divisions: prescription pharmaceuticals, consumer health, nutrition, and distribution & logistics. Within these divisions, Kalbe manages a diverse portfolio reinforced by a robust distribution network that serves over one million outlets across Indonesia’s vast archipelago.

On the international stage, Kalbe has established a strong presence in ASEAN countries, as well as regions spanning East and South Asia, the Middle East, and Africa. Kalbe’s business ventures are supported by best in- class research and development capabilities, developed through strategic alliances with many international partners. The Company is deeply involved in cutting-edge areas such as drug delivery systems, cancer treatment, stem cell research, and biotechnology.
